description: Thermal model parameters for scripts/kit thermal analyze. Values below are typical literature defaults, not data for your laminate or enclosure: replace them with datasheet or measured values. Copper thickness null = take it from the board stack-up (0.035 mm if the board has none).
notes: 2026-11-18: via_plating 0.018 mm = IPC-6012 class 2 thinnest point (fabrication requirement, rev1-platzierung 3a). Ambient for the D501 check: 65 degC (O-16) via --ambient.
